title: Preparation and characterization of heteroatom self-doped activated biocarbons as hydrogen storage and supercapacitor electrode materials
material_description: ACBS12 | N/O heteroatom self-doped activated biocarbon from sword bean (Canavalia gladiata) shells carbonized at 723 K for 1 h under N2 (5 K/min, 500 mL/min), then KOH-activated at 1073 K for 2 h, KOH/char mass ratio 2
purification_method: precursor shells washed with tap water and dried at 323 K for 3 days; activated product washed several times with 1 M HCl and deionized water, Soxhlet extraction for 3 days, oven-dried overnight
activation_method: KOH activation of the sword bean shell charcoal (100-200 um powder), KOH/char mass ratio 2, heated to 1073 K and held 2 h under N2 (500 mL/min)
